citation.note: Inspiration4 was a 3-day mission with no in-flight blood/urine draws, so it cannot supply a long-duration TREND shape — that still comes from published NASA HRP / peer-reviewed literature (see backend/config.py reference_note per indicator). What real clinical panels on 4 real people DO supply is real inter-individual variability: some people naturally swing more than others. Selecting a data profile calibrates simulated day-to-day noise to a real crew member's own preflight variability — it does not mean the simulated long-duration trajectory IS that person's real data.
